# Teeth Done in Turkey

> UK patient guide and booking site for dental treatment in Turkey — veneers, dental implants, and full smile makeovers at JCI-accredited clinics, with UK-based support and monthly payment plans. Save up to 70% vs UK private dentistry prices.

Teeth Done in Turkey helps UK patients research, compare, and book dental treatment in Turkey. All partner clinics are JCI-accredited with English-speaking dentists using the same brands as UK practices (Straumann and Nobel Biocare implants, Ivoclar E-max veneers), backed by guarantees of up to 10 years. Monthly payment plans start from £82/month with 0% interest available over 12, 24 or 36 months. All prices are in GBP for a UK audience; package prices include hotel accommodation and VIP airport transfers unless stated otherwise. Contact: hello@teethdoneinturkey.co.uk, WhatsApp +90 535 399 8999.

## Affordability & Access Guides (UK NHS access, emergency dental, treatment costs)

- [Can't Afford Dental Treatment in the UK?](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/cant-afford-dental-treatment-uk): NHS charges, private costs, payment plans, dental finance and treatment abroad, in decision order. Hub for the full affordability cluster.
- [Can't Find an NHS Dentist? Step-by-Step Options](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/no-nhs-dentist-what-to-do): NHS 111 dental referral, NHS emergency dental services, Community Dental Services (CDS), dental schools, and realistic alternatives for UK patients who cannot find an NHS practice accepting patients. NHS band charges: Band 1 £27.90, Band 2 £76.60, Band 3 £306.80 (England, April 2026).
- [Can't Afford a Root Canal UK?](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/cant-afford-root-canal-uk): Root canal on the NHS costs £76.60 (Band 2, England). Private costs £500–£1,500 (front tooth to molar) plus £800–£1,000 crown. Root canal + crown in Turkey: £330–£580. Root canal vs extraction honest comparison, risks of delay, payment plans from £10/month.
- [Tooth Abscess Can't Afford a Dentist?](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/tooth-abscess-cant-afford-dentist): YMYL emergency guide. Call NHS 111 (dial 111) if you cannot access a dentist — free referral to NHS emergency dental service. Go to A&E or call 999 for facial swelling, fever above 38°C, difficulty swallowing/breathing. Antibiotics buy time but do not cure an abscess. Medically reviewed.
- [Severe Toothache Can't Afford a Dentist?](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/severe-toothache-cant-afford-dentist): NHS 111 provides 24/7 dental referral at no upfront cost. Common causes: pulpitis, abscess, cracked tooth, lost filling. Temporary relief (ibuprofen, clove oil, cold compress) reduces pain — not a substitute for treatment. A&E escalation criteria included. Medically reviewed.
